nodes.title: Markdown Note: Usage
widgets_values:
🔗 MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning

### Write a long prompt, not a short one
Describe who, outfit, place, light and framing; a short prompt falls back to a glossy, beauty-filtered doll face and a generic scene.

### Add phone-camera words for a real photo look
End with words such as "Shot on the iPhone 16 Pro front camera", "visible skin texture and pores", "no retouching", "natural phone HDR", "not cinematic, not studio".

### No prompt enhancer needed
A prompt enhancer is optional; with a hand-written prompt it only adds 3 to 4 minutes.

### Keep the size near 16 MP
At 4 MP, faces come out crunchy or mushy, and 16 MP costs only about 9 s more sampling. Other shapes: "4736" x "3552" (4:3), "5472" x "3072" (16:9), "4096" x "4096" (1:1).

nodes.title: Markdown Note: Usage / Caution
widgets_values:
🔗 SamplerLCM, BasicScheduler

### Why SamplerLCM at 6 steps
With euler at 16 MP, skin and hair get a blocky "compressed video" texture and over-sharpened HDR; SamplerLCM with s_noise 1.10 falling to 0.90 over 6 simple steps gives clean skin with pores and clean eyes and teeth, even on small faces.

### A simpler option with one dropdown
A plain KSampler with sampler_name "lcm", scheduler "simple" and 4 steps is almost as good, a little softer.

widgets_values:
## What this workflow does

Turns a long, hand-written prompt into one realistic photo of about 16 MP (3552x4736, portrait 3:4) with MiniMax H3 Image.

## models

- diffusion_models
  - [minimax_h3_image_*.gguf](huggingface.co/molbal/miniMax-H3-Image-GGUF) (21 GB)
- text_encoders
  - [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (15.69 GB)
- vae
  - [minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors) (1.17 GB)

Text encoder for your graphics card: The NVFP4 text encoder runs natively on RTX 50-series cards; on other cards, the int8_convrot version of the same text encoder is an option: [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) (25.28 GB), same folder.

```text
📂ComfyUI/
└── 📂models/
    ├── 📂diffusion_models/
    │   └── minimax_h3_image_*.gguf
    ├── 📂text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
    └── 📂vae/
        └── minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors
```
